in_sanskrit.name: Yograj
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the king of the union of body, mind, and soul.

in_marathi.name: Yograj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Yoga
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yograj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yograj means 'God of Yoga'. Yoga is a practice of mindfulness, meditation, and physical postures to attain spiritual growth. This name signifies the power and strength one gains through the practice of yoga and the wisdom it brings, leading to a joyful and fulfilling life.
